title: Food Critic: An Agentic Visualization System for Auditable Restaurant-Safety Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.15843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI agents are increasingly being embedded into visualization systems that can search data, invoke tools, summarize evidence, and produce recommendations. However, when agents rely solely on their own knowledge, the visualization problem is not only whether the agent provides a useful answer, but also whether users can inspect how that answer is grounded. We present Food Critic, an agentic visualization system for diners' restaurant decision support that integrates public health inspection records with crowd review data. The system grounds agents under three conditions: a database-only ReAct agent, a retrieval- augmented agent with access to food-safety regulations, and an ontology-guided agent that produces structured hypotheses and typed evidence. translated_title: Food Critic：一个用于可审计餐厅安全推理的智能体可视化系统
translated_abstract: 生成式AI智能体正越来越多地被嵌入到能够搜索数据、调用工具、总结证据并生成推荐的可视化系统中。然而，当智能体仅依赖自身知识时，可视化的问题不仅在于智能体是否能提供有用的答案，还在于用户能否检查该答案背后的依据。我们提出了Food Critic，一个面向食客餐厅决策支持的智能体可视化系统，它将公共卫生检查记录与大众评论数据整合在一起。该系统在三种条件下为智能体提供依据支撑：仅依赖数据库的ReAct智能体、可访问食品安全法规的检索增强智能体，以及能够生成结构化假设和类型化证据的本体引导智能体。Food Critic将智能体在这些依据条件下的推理外化为可检查的视觉证据。我们在每种依据条件下通过多个用例对大语言模型进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出Food Critic系统，通过三种依据条件（仅数据库ReAct、检索增强、本体引导）将智能体的餐厅安全推理过程外化为可检查的视觉证据，实现了可审计的食客决策支持可视化。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Food Critic, an agentic visualization system that grounds restaurant-safety agents under three conditions—database-only ReAct, retrieval-augmented, and ontology-guided—to externalize agent reasoning as inspectable visual evidence for auditable diner decision support.
